title: Sportsbet Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of International All Sports Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Sportsbet intended to acquire all of the outstanding shares (approximately 80%) in International All Sports that it did not already own.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the competitive effects of the proposed acquisition in the context of: - a national wagering market; and - a national sports betting market.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets. Factors informing this conclusion included: - the presence of a number of alternative suppliers of wagering and sports betting services, including other corporate bookmakers and the state based totalisators; and - the transparency in pricing, and the ability of punters to readily compare odds between the totalisator and bookmakers.
